messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Backtransform output
parts:
Hi Cathy,

I like to use
str(x)
That will give you better detail on how to call things from inside more complex structures.

then you can use
x@estimate
But, couldn't easily see how to call the other things from in this structure; often they are nested so you have to do
x@something$something

Sarah


On Thu, Oct 25, 2012 at 2:26 PM, cb <cathy...@fs.fed.us> wrote:
I have a basic R question....(I am still on the learning curve).
 
Is there a way to access the objects (output)  created by Backtransform?  My goal is just to automate the creation of a summary table of output.
I get the following errors:
 
> x=backTransform(fm5, type="psi")
> x
Backtransformed linear combination(s) of Initial estimate(s)
 Estimate     SE LinComb (Intercept)
    0.559 0.0656   0.237           1
Transformation: logistic
> names(x)
NULL
> x[1]
Error in x[1] : object of type 'S4' is not subsettable
> x@Estimate
Error: no slot of name "Estimate" for this object of class "unmarkedBackTrans"
>
 
Thanks!
 
cb
